subject: re-st
title: (R)RE.ST. ------ POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 175 (SR(TRS)II-31). RE-ST (restructuralism) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From DYM-SPT: RIT-DY (ritual dynamics). From T-C-IMP: EXTN (existentialism). From RIT-DY: POST (postulation). From EXTN: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From POST: IST-P. From IF-ST-DY: METH. From METH: EXT-FT (extended functionalism).
